chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Muhammad ibn Ja'far reported to me from Hisham ibn Yunus al-Nahshali, who reported from Abu Muhammad al-Ansari, who reported from Abu Bakr ibn Ayyash, from Muhammad ibn Shihab al-Zuhri, from Anas ibn Malik, who said:

"The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, looked at Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, and said: O Ali, whoever hates you, Allah shall cause him to die the death of jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic ignorance) and will hold him to account for what he did on the Day of Judgement."

key_terms.حاسب: To hold to account; divine reckoning
key_terms.ميتة جاهلية: Death of jahiliyyah; dying as one who lived in pre-Islamic ignorance

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about those who hate Imam Ali?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAW) looked at Imam Ali (AS) and declared that whoever harbors hatred for Ali will die the death of jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic ignorance) and will face accountability for his deeds on the Day of Judgement. This hadith, narrated through the famous Sunni chain of al-Zuhri from Anas ibn Malik, establishes the love of Ali as an essential article of faith, equating its rejection with dying outside the fold of Islam.
word_analysis: and will hold him to account
